newsitem.title: USA: WMS Industries files for IPO offering.
newsitem.headline: WMS Industries files for IPO offering.

text.p: WMS Industries Inc said Friday it filed for the initial public offering of about 15 percent of its coin-operated video game and home video game business, Midway Games Inc.

It said it filed its Form S-1 registration statement in preparation for Midway's initial public offering of 5.1 million shares (5.9 million if the underwriters' overallotment option is exercised). WMS said the anticipated initial offering price will be between $20 and $22 per share.

Midway will have outstanding 38.5 million shares upon completion of the offering, or 39.3 million if the underwriters' overallotment option is fully exercised. WMS will own 33.4 million of the shares.
The managing underwriters of the offering, which is expected to start in late October, are Oppenheimer & Co Inc, Hambrecht & Quist LLC, UBS Securities LLC and Wasserstein Perella Securities Inc.
Midway intends to use proceeds of the offering for working capital, to pay a $50 million dividend note owed to the company and to repay seasonal working capital borrowings from the company.
